basic_info.name: Flipkart
basic_info.description: At Flipkart, we're driven by our purpose of empowering every Indian's dream by delivering value through innovation in technology and commerce. With a customer base of over 350 million, product coverage of over 150 million across 80+ categories, a focus on generating direct and indirect employment and a commitment to empowering generations of entrepreneurs and MSMEs, all driven by a sustainable growth strategy – Flipkart is maximising for customers, stakeholders, and the planet at large!At Flipkart, our promise to every Flipster is - getting an opportunity to leave a mark and create their own legacy, the freedom to experiment, learn and grow, work with the industry’s brightest minds as part of a diverse team and we will extend our culture of care to them to ensure that they can focus on doing their best work. Driven by audacity, bias for action, customer first, integrity and inclusion – Flipsters have pioneered solutions that have transformed digital commerce in India. From the industry-first introduction of cash-on-delivery in 2010 to the launch of voice search and multiple vernacular interfaces in 2021 that have made e-commerce a very inclusive experience, Flipkart continues the exciting journey of solving for the Indian customer. We understand that your own aspirations and journeys are unique. So you choose what you want to maximise, and we provide you the platform for it - because when you maximise, we maximise.   Flipkart is a part of the Walmart-owned Flipkart Group, which also includes group companies Flipkart Wholesale, Flipkart Health+, Cleartrip, and Myntra.Get in touch with our experts for support with your orders here: https://www.flipkart.com/helpcentre

basic_info.description: Flipkart Marketplace is India’s leading platform for selling online. All you need is to register, list your catalog and start selling your products.What's more? Combine these with the fastest payments in the industry and you get an excellent seller portal. No wonder Flipkart is India’s favourite place to sell online.

basic_info.name: Flipkart Commerce Cloud
basic_info.description: Flipkart Commerce Cloud (FCC) is the commerce technology stack built by retailers, for retailers.Our platform powers one of the world's largest marketplaces, and now brings that same battle-tested technology to retailers and e-commerce businesses globally. Every solution is proven across 1.5B+ annual orders and 350M+ shoppers, refined over 15 years and 25 million engineering hours of running retail at extreme scale.What we offer:Digital Commerce: Search and product discovery, personalization, catalog management, composable storefront, cart and checkout, and a complete supply chain suite covering order management, warehousing, and inventory.Competitive Intelligence: Real-time tracking of competitor prices and market movements across millions of products, so every pricing decision starts with the full picture.Retail Media: Display, product listing, and contextual ads that turn your traffic into high-margin revenue.Everyone is talking about AI. We believe it only works on a strong commerce core. Without clean catalog data, accurate inventory, reliable orders, and a clear view of the market, AI has nothing to act on. That core is what we build, run, and prove every day.Our work has been recognized with a Gold Stevie Award for Technological Innovation of the Year (2026), placements in multiple IDC MarketScape vendor assessments for retail search and order orchestration, and the Summit International Award for our #ByRetailersForRetailers campaign.Headquartered in Bengaluru with teams across India and the United States, we deploy and support retailers worldwide.See our technology on your own catalog, same day, no integration: https://www.flipkartcommercecloud.com/book-a-demo
